description: Create one shift on a schedule — assigned to a user, or open (user_id 0). Created as a draft unless published is true. Undo by editing it or unpublishing. When I Work: POST /2/shifts.

break_time.description: Unpaid break length in hours, e.g. 0.5.

is_shared.description: For an open shift: a shared open shift.

location_id.description: The schedule (location) the shift belongs to id.

notes.description: Shift notes shown to the employee.

start_time.description: Shift start, date-time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00.

user_id.description: The user to assign. 0 (or omitted on create) makes it an open shift.
